name: Resistor with disconnecting slider
aliases: Resistor with disconnecting slider IEC reference
summary: This form distinguishes a movable resistor contact with a disconnecting position.
description: This form distinguishes a movable resistor contact with a disconnecting position. The movable contact can leave the resistive track at its documented disconnecting position. This changes circuit continuity as well as the selected resistance.
Show the track ends, slider terminal and the off-position relationship. A generic potentiometer or variable-resistor graphic can omit this important additional operating state.
readingNotes: Show the track terminals, movable contact and the circuit condition at the off position.
A disconnecting slider is different from a continuously connected potentiometer wiper.
